summary: FD_TC_173_Mixed Regime � APPR + EU Eligible (APPR Most Generous at Higher Tier)
title: Mixed Regime � APPR + EU Eligible (APPR Most Generous at Higher Tier)
description:
Mixed Regime � APPR + EU Eligible (EU Still Selected at 10hr Delay per Fixed Priority). Same dual-regime route (CDG?YYZ, EU + APPR) but at 10-hour delay. Under the fixed priority hierarchy, EU is ALWAYS selected over APPR regardless of delay duration. At 10hr delay: APPR Tier 3 = $1,000 CAD, EU (EU261) = �600 (fixed by distance band, does NOT increase with longer delays). Despite APPR's higher CAD amount, EU is still selected per the fixed priority. Validates that the fixed priority does NOT flip at higher delay tiers � EU always wins over APPR. Tests that DDS does NOT perform a CAD conversion comparison to override the fixed hierarchy.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Jean-Marc Rousseau), 1 leg AC operated CDG?YYZ. Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 10:00 (YYZ local), Actual arrival 20:00 (10hr delay). Disruption code: 42(Controllable). Booking changes: None. Carrier: AC only. Route context: EU origin (CDG) ? EU 261; Canada arrival ? APPR.
